column1: # IEEE Std 1364-2005 clause list: every numbered heading of the standard, the
# denominator of `zig build test-1364 -- --coverage`. The PDF is licensed and
# not in git, so this file is its committed stand-in; titles are headings, no
# body text is reproduced. 672 rows are the table of contents
# and 136 are the body's depth-4+ headings the contents omit (4.6.3.1,
# The second column is reviewed and never regenerated.
#   kind  `-`: an ordinary clause, counted by its fixtures' cites.
#         otherwise the CLAUSE-AUDIT §5 kinds the AMS CLAUSES.tsv files use
#         resource-limit, unspecified), with the evidence column required.
